baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction li-ayatina anidan directs the predicate toward the signs, while kalla rejects the preceding expectation.
baseline_models.mechanism: A visible marker offers orientation, while anid supplies deviation from straightness and active resistance to truth; kana makes that counter-alignment an established temporal state rather than a single reaction.

activation_trace.role: Temporal occurrence and predication make the resistant stance an established state.
The visible-sign image supplies a manifest marker capable of orienting a response.
Deviation from straightness and resistance to truth supply the active counter-alignment.

changed_reading.before: He simply failed to accept the signs.
changed_reading.after: He occupied an established counter-position against signs manifest enough to orient him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Anidan can image a lean to one side and separation from the group, still governed by li-ayatina.
baseline_models.mechanism: The signs mark a shared field of visibility, but the predicate images a self-positioning off to the side; resistance is spatial and relational, not only an opinion held internally.

activation_trace.role: The visible marker supplies the common orienting field from which separation can occur.
Sideward leaning and isolation supply the posture of deliberate relational separation.

changed_reading.before: Obstinacy is a fixed personality trait.
changed_reading.after: Obstinacy is an enacted side-position that separates the person from the signs' shared line of orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Extended support, present witnesses, and prepared ease form a personally inhabited field of signs; desire for another increase converts received provision into entitlement and resistance to its evidentiary force.

activation_trace.role: The visible-sign image lets prior provision function as evidence within the focus wording.
Resistance to truth names the refusal to let received goods carry evidentiary force.
Connected increase that supplies another images wealth as continuing support rather than self-produced possession.
Presence with witnessing makes the surrounding benefit immediate and publicly inspectable.
Preparation and leveling supply the made-ready conditions in which the person stands.
The heart's expectant desire turns prior gifts into an anticipated claim on more.
Seeking increase supplies the specific demand that kalla interrupts before naming resistance.

structural_cues: 74:11-14 moves from solitary creation through extended wealth, present sons, and prepared ease.
74:15 asks for still more, and 74:16 opens with kalla before naming the relation to the signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of received supports followed by desire for increase; I infer that the supports themselves become signs and that entitlement supplies the arrow into resistance. A live alternative is that ayatina refers more narrowly to revealed verses.

changed_reading.before: He resists signs presented as external messages.
changed_reading.after: He resists the signs embedded in his own provision by treating sustained support as warrant for further increase.

context_deltas.mechanism: The chosen deviation from a straight orienting sign is answered immediately by an imposed, exhausting ascent: self-directed counteralignment is reversed into coerced difficult motion.

activation_trace.role: Deviation from straightness supplies the chosen directional disorder whose consequence is spatially mirrored.
Imposing what heavily burdens supplies coercive load as the immediate consequence.
The steep, arduous ascent turns resistance's spatial image into punitive motion.

structural_cues: 74:17 follows the focus ayah without an intervening scene and announces an imposed ascent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deviation, burdening, and arduous ascent; I infer a mirroring arrow from chosen misalignment to forced motion. The live alternative is simple consequence without a deliberately matched spatial form.

changed_reading.before: The predicate names culpable opposition and the next ayah merely states punishment.
changed_reading.after: The punishment answers the predicate's geometry: one who chose counteralignment is made to undergo an exhausting directed ascent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Resistance unfolds as a production sequence: inward circulation, calculated framing, inspection, bodily turning away, self-magnification, and finally a spoken label that redescribes the sign as transmitted deception.

activation_trace.role: The visible sign is the evidentiary object processed by the later sequence.
Active resistance to truth names the governing direction of the interpretive sequence.
The heart's repeated circulation around a matter supplies the inward processing stage.
Managing a matter through calculation and consideration supplies deliberate framing.
Directed sight or insight confirms that the verdict follows inspection rather than simple non-exposure.
Turning one's back and averting supplies the bodily enactment of the chosen conclusion.
Greatness and pride supply self-elevation as the motive coupled to withdrawal.
Spoken utterance externalizes the manufactured judgment into a public claim.
Diversion and deception supply the reductive category imposed on the sign.
A report transmitted until it becomes received lore supplies the claim that the message is merely inherited.

structural_cues: 74:18-23 gives a staged sequence of thinking, estimating, looking, facial contraction, turning away, and self-magnification.
74:24-25 ends that sequence with two reductive spoken classifications.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered cognition, inspection, recoil, pride, and utterance; I infer that the resistant orientation governs the sequence and makes the final label outcome-directed. Deliberation could initially have been open, but the post-inspection turning and self-magnification leave manufactured judgment materially live.

changed_reading.before: Anid names static stubbornness in the face of a message.
changed_reading.after: Anid compresses an active interpretive workflow that inspects a sign, calculates a rival frame, recoils, and publicly relabels it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A counted datum becomes an assay whose same presentation stabilizes knowledge and belief in some while agitating doubt and exposing disequilibrium in others; a sign therefore diagnoses orientation as well as conveying content.

activation_trace.role: The visible-sign image anchors the later counted datum as an instance of manifest evidence.
Deviation and resistance name one exposed reception-state rather than a lack of presented evidence.
Enumeration supplies the precise datum around which divergent responses form.
Testing metal or a person supplies the assay mechanism that reveals what reception is made of.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies one positive product of the assay.
Heart-settling assent supplies the receptive trajectory strengthened by the same datum.
Agitated doubt supplies the contrasting destabilized reception-state.
Departure from health and equilibrium supplies the precondition exposed by hostile questioning.

structural_cues: 74:31 explicitly calls the number a test and places certainty, increased faith, non-doubt, and hostile questioning around the same datum.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one counted object, calls it an assay, and lists opposed reception outcomes; I infer that signs can expose prior orientation rather than mechanically compel assent. Alternatively, the ayah may describe this particular count without generalizing the mechanism to every sign in 74:16.

changed_reading.before: A sign succeeds only if it directly persuades its hearer.
changed_reading.after: A sign may also succeed diagnostically: the same evidence discloses settled receptivity or the resistant disequilibrium named in 74:16.

context_deltas.mechanism: Moonlight, departing night, first light, and uncovering dawn turn the sign into a perceptual transition from concealment to disclosure; the sequence then names a warning, so visibility itself carries summons and consequence.

activation_trace.role: The visible-sign image anchors the cosmic sequence as enacted disclosure.
Resistance to truth becomes resistance to a disclosure unfolding in plain perception.
The moon and its light supply the first directly visible oath-object.
Night and its darkness supply the covering state from which disclosure proceeds.
A thing's ending and passing supply darkness's withdrawal in the visual sequence.
Dawn as the first of day supplies the arrival of a new perceptual state.
Removing a cover supplies disclosure as the operative action of dawn.
A warning that awakens caution converts cosmic visibility into an address requiring response.

structural_cues: Kalla recurs at 74:32 before the oath sequence of 74:32-34.
74:35-36 identifies what follows the sequence as one of the great matters and a warning to humanity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cover-to-light sequence followed by warning; I infer that the sequence models how a sign discloses and summons. A live alternative is that the cosmic objects validate the warning as oaths without semantically expanding ayatina in 74:16.

changed_reading.before: The signs are chiefly verbal propositions that can be accepted or denied.
changed_reading.after: The signs also arrive as staged unveilings in perception, and resistance refuses the warning-force of what becomes visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated temporal predication distributes the resistant state across omitted worship, withheld feeding, collective immersion in talk, and denial of reckoning until certainty arrives; the focus predicate becomes a practiced social history rather than one inner judgment.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication anchors the focus predicate as a state capable of habitual extension.
Resistance to truth supplies the orientation expressed through the later pattern of conduct.
Repeated temporal predication opens the retrospective list of what the speakers used to be and do.
Specific worship supplies one concrete relation whose habitual absence embodies resistance.
Feeding another supplies the social obligation whose omission makes resistance materially visible.
Entering a discourse or affair supplies collective participation that sustains the practiced state.
Attributing falsehood supplies the explicit verbal practice continuous with the focus resistance.
Reckoning and recompense supply the denied horizon that would otherwise order conduct.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed marks the endpoint at which the habitual pattern can no longer continue.

structural_cues: 74:43-46 repeats a past-state construction across a four-part plural confession.
The list combines omitted ritual and social acts with collective discourse and explicit denial, then closes at 74:47 with certainty's arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a plural retrospective pattern, not an explicit identity statement about the singular person in 74:16; I infer a typological expansion from his established state to the conduct that such resistance can organize. The alternative is to keep the two scenes referentially separate.

changed_reading.before: He was obstinate as an individual intellectual disposition.
changed_reading.after: He inhabited a durable mode of life in which worship, social care, peer discourse, and eschatological judgment were jointly counteraligned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The side-position of anid becomes kinetic: the reminder is met by turning one's side, recoiling to create distance, and fleeing a pursuer. Defiance can therefore mask reactive evasion rather than stable strength.

activation_trace.role: Sideward leaning and separation anchor the flight scene as a dynamic form of focus obstinacy.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the proximal sign from which the group recoils.
Turning one's side away supplies the first bodily phase of evasive resistance.
Recoiling and increasing distance supply the accelerating withdrawal.
Flight and escape reveal the apparent firmness of defiance as urgent evasion.
The pursuing force supplies the perceived pressure that organizes the flight response.

structural_cues: 74:49 asks why they are turning away from the reminder, and 74:50-51 renders that withdrawal as a flight simile.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies side-turning, recoil, escape, and pursuit; I infer that these motions disclose an affective underside to anid. The simile may instead emphasize absurdity and speed without diagnosing fear or inner fragility.

changed_reading.before: The resistant person stands immovably firm against the signs.
changed_reading.after: The resistant posture is also a flight pattern: it creates distance from a reminder experienced as pursuit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Each individual seeks to be handed an opened written sheet; resistance manages admissibility by refusing shared signs unless evidence arrives privatized, directly delivered, and displayed on the person's own terms.

activation_trace.role: A sign deliberately taken as a mark or target anchors the question of how evidence is selected and addressed.
Active resistance supplies the refusal enacted through imposed conditions of evidence.
Seeking a thing supplies the active demand rather than passive uncertainty.
The individual person supplies the demand's one-by-one personalization.
Giving or delivering supplies the requested direct transfer of authorization.
A written sheet supplies the demanded evidentiary medium.
Opening and spreading supplies evidence displayed fully before each recipient.

structural_cues: 74:52 distributes the request across every individual and asks for separately delivered, opened sheets.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies individualized seeking, delivery, writing, and opening; I infer an evidentiary-control strategy in which shared signs are rejected unless personalized. The request could instead be mockery or a status claim rather than a sincere rule of admissibility.

changed_reading.after: Resistance can demand evidence selectively, disqualifying common signs while insisting on bespoke written authorization.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus still predicates real resistance of the person, but the close places human willing-to-remember inside divine willing; this weakens any causally closed account in which obstinacy or recollection is wholly self-generated.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication preserves the person's resistance as a genuinely enacted state.
Active counteralignment preserves the focus ayah's attribution of responsibility.
Willing directed toward a thing supplies the human volitional opening to remember.
Bringing something to presence after or with memory supplies the alternative to resistant avoidance.
The same willing image, now attributed to God, supplies the encompassing condition on recollection.
The divine name identifies whose willing encompasses the human act without erasing its attribution.

structural_cues: 74:55 opens remembrance to whoever wills, while 74:56 immediately conditions remembrance on God's willing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both human and divine willing around one act of remembrance; I infer nested rather than rival agency, retaining the focus attribution while denying causal closure. A live alternative is that the close addresses the audience generally and should not modify the causal reading of the individual in 74:16.

changed_reading.before: The established resistant state is a wholly self-originating and self-sustaining identity.
changed_reading.after: The resistance remains an accountable enacted posture, but access to its opposite, recollection, is not portrayed as autonomous.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch image of an obliquely flowing stream rather than the ordinary moral sense of anid. It remains anchored in the focus predicate and is activated by packet images of path-entry and wading into a medium; downstream prose should mark it as a spatial-material analogy, not a lexical replacement for obstinacy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Anidan at 74:16 carries a branch image of a stream that runs obliquely aside.

activation_trace.role: The obliquely running stream supplies resistance as redirected flow rather than a stationary barrier.
Penetrating or proceeding along a path supplies the directional channel from which the flow departs.
Entering water supplies a shared medium in which collective movement can carry and redirect the person.

changed_reading.before: Obstinacy is a solid obstruction that does not move.
changed_reading.after: Obstinacy may be imaged as a countercurrent: active movement within a shared medium that persistently swerves away from the orienting path.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the old 'I used to' man is a remote idiomatic branch of kana, not the verse's grammatical gloss. It remains anchored in kana and is activated by the later repeated past-state confession and reminder sequence; downstream prose should present it only as a rhetorical temporal echo, never as the literal meaning of kana in 74:16.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Kana in 74:16 can remotely evoke the branch image of a person defined by repeatedly saying what he used to be.

activation_trace.role: The old 'I used to' figure supplies a retrospective identity built from habitual past predication.
Temporal predication begins the later confession's repeated account of what the speakers used to do.
The reminder image supplies the retrospective horizon in which an established past becomes legible.

changed_reading.before: Kana only locates obstinacy as a past or established state.
changed_reading.after: The phrase can faintly foreshadow a future retrospective dossier: resistance becomes the defining 'used to' from which a life is later recounted.

strongest_changes: The pre-focus gifts recast signs as personally inhabited supports whose evidentiary force is resisted through entitlement.
The post-focus thinking sequence turns static stubbornness into an engineered interpretive verdict.
The count-as-test scene makes signs diagnostic assays that expose certainty, trust, doubt, or disequilibrium.
The plural confession expands an established predicate into a practiced ritual, social, discursive, and eschatological pattern.
The flight simile reveals that apparent defiant firmness can operate as rapid evasive distance-making.
summary.what_was_special: Across the packet, a compact moral predicate repeatedly becomes a mechanism: received support becomes entitlement, inspection becomes calculated relabeling, evidence becomes assay and unveiling, settled state becomes social practice, and side-position becomes flight.
remaining_uncertainties: Ayatina may refer chiefly to revealed verses rather than also gathering biographical provision and cosmic disclosure.
The singular focus figure and the later plural confessors or fleeing crowd support typological comparison, not certain referential identity.
The final relation of human and divine willing may frame the surah generally rather than directly weaken an autonomous reading of 74:16.
The countercurrent and retrospective 'used to' readings are analogical branch activations and should not displace the ordinary syntax.
